## Required review checklist

- [ ] This change is connected to [MILESTONES.md](../MILESTONES.md) and does not relabel historical evidence.
- [ ] Product core, current engine and private source-owner boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Exact before/after source or document hashes and a bounded diff are available to the authorized reviewer.
- [ ] Actual tests (PASS/FAIL/SKIP) and adversarial negatives are recorded, or clearly NOT_RUN.
- [ ] A dated new [milestone report](../milestones/REPORT_TEMPLATE.md) accompanies any *accepted* PASS/seal.
- [ ] Provider/model measurements, CPU/GPU/energy, costs and matched baselines are labeled by actual evidence class.
- [ ] No secrets, source IP, customer IDs, internal raw receipts or private test contracts are published.
- [ ] Prior scientific FAILs, including Four-Arm R1, remain unaltered.
- [ ] No beta/Hostinger/domain or genuine CC claim is inferred from LAB_ONLY or QUALIFICATION_ONLY results.
- [ ] Owner reviews the exact promotion/merge/release separately from accepting the PR.
